title: Extended Benefits First Monetary Determination on Unemployment Benefit Claims
content:
The first Extended Benefits determination on a filed Extended Benefits (EB) claim of Unemployment Benefit Claims fixes its maximum benefit amount from the parent claim named on it, copies the parent's weekly benefit amount and dependency allowance, credits the maximum benefit amount to the Extended Benefits claim's remaining balance and makes the claim active.

## Conditions on the determination

- The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is fixed only after the parent claim's last paid week carries a supplemental payment for its shortfall.
- The Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount is not fixed until the parent claim's dependency allowance counts every dependent added to the record.

Both are states of the parent claim's records: the payment history of its last paid week, and the dependents counted in its dependency allowance against the dependents on record.

## Business effect

On success the Extended Benefits claim shows the weekly benefit amount and dependency allowance carried from its parent claim, the determined maximum benefit amount, an equal remaining balance, monetary status eligible, determination number 1, the day of the call as its monetary determination date and status active; its payment history gains one entitlement-credit entry for the maximum benefit amount.

## Invocation

The function is `determine_extension_entitlement_db601fac`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `claim_id` | The claim reference number of the filed Extended Benefits claim, read from the claim lookup before the call | Identifier |
| `parent_claim_id` | The claim reference number of the parent claim the Extended Benefits claim extends, read from the parent field of the Extended Benefits claim | Identifier |
| `weekly_benefit_amount` | The weekly benefit amount carried to the Extended Benefits claim | USD, whole dollars with 2 decimal places |
| `dependency_allowance` | The weekly dependency allowance carried to the Extended Benefits claim | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `max_benefit_amount` | The determined Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount | USD, whole dollars with 2 decimal places |

## Return

A successful call returns `entry_id` (the entitlement-credit reference number), `claim_id`, `status` (active), `max_benefit_amount` (USD) and `remaining_balance` (USD). Receiving `entry_id` means the determination is recorded.

### Hypothetical input and return

A call with a maximum benefit amount of 2349.00 returns status active, a maximum benefit amount of 2349.00 and a remaining balance of 2349.00.
